newsitem.title: USA: Pirelli unit sues Ciena in patent dispute.
newsitem.headline: Pirelli unit sues Ciena in patent dispute.

text.p: The Pirelli Cable Corp unit of the Italian tire and cable company Pirelli has filed suit against the Ciena Corp in a U.S. patent dispute.
In papers filed Friday in the U.S. District Court in Delaware, Pirelli alleged that five of its patents in fiber- optic technology are being infringed by Ciena fiber-optic products.

The patents at issue are for an "amplifier adapter for optical lines," an "optical fibre amplifier", and "fiber optical communication line with shut off control" and two patents for an "optical fiber telecommunications line".
Pirelli Cable is a Lexington, South Carolina-based developer of fiber-optics technology.
Ciena, of Savage, Maryland, makes high capacity fiber optic transmission systems for public networks.
A Ciena spokesman could not be reached for comment.
